rapport_notes: Great transparency; patiently re-walked the pricing math twice when the customer got confused, without getting defensive about her comparison shopping.

evidence_quotes.agenda: "do you have any special instructions, concerns or stresser about moving in general that you want me to take note of at this time?"
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Customer didn't understand the question at first; rep rephrased it ("any access issues, items requiring special consideration") and got only a routine TV-wrap answer — N/A/full credit, no real concern surfaced.
evidence_quotes.save_your_ass: "Once we go over the minimum we only charge in fifteen minute intervals" — reiterated with a full worked example when the customer asked for the math.

top_strength: When the customer got confused doing the math live on the call, patiently re-walked through the exact calculation twice without getting flustered, prompting her to call the pricing "very reasonable."
coaching_note: Add a "does that feel fair?" pause after the pricing explanation — the whole close here is business math with no room left for the customer to react before moving on.
